messages.author: 208520df5a1c57c2
messages.subject: Left truncation in MRDS
parts:
Hello

I am analysing a dataset that shows reduced sighting frequency close
to the trackline, probably because of an obscured view. I am using
left truncation in conventional models, but left truncation is not
supported in MRDS models.

So, I was considering left-truncating the data outside of DISTANCE,
then subtracting the left truncation distance from all the remaining
distances, then running MRDS models without left truncation. Would
this produce valid results or am I missing something important here?

Thanks,

Daniel Pike.

messages.author: 4b4a7b00c1dd09c7
messages.subject: Re: Left truncation in MRDS
parts:
Hi Dan,

I assume that, because you're using MRDS, you have double-observer data.
In this case, there's no downside I can think of to the strategy you
suggest. If you have single observer data, then you would be assuming
that detection probability at the left truncation distance is 1.0, but
this is reasonable in many cases anyway.

Cheers, - Len
